preconditions.before: Drag a library AGR onto a clip; or double-click it in browser.
preconditions.after: Drag a library AGR onto a clip; or double-click it in browser. Or select a pooled entry with the Clip Groove chooser.

contract.before: Dropping assigns/applies groove timing to clip; double-click loads it into Groove Pool before assignment. Pool contains loaded and assigned grooves; unused entries have grayed parameters. Duplicate import/identity handling U.
contract.after: Dropping assigns/applies groove timing to clip; double-click loads it into Groove Pool before assignment. Pool contains loaded and assigned grooves; unused entries have grayed parameters. Duplicate import/identity handling U. The Clip Groove chooser selects the groove for a clip from entries available in the Groove Pool.

contract.before: Write groove result: MIDI notes move; audio obtains Warp Markers at appropriate positions. Assignment then becomes None. Exact note/velocity/marker data, duplicate/endpoint marker policy, random realization, repeat commit and undo scope U.
contract.after: Write groove result: MIDI notes move; audio obtains Warp Markers at appropriate positions. Assignment then becomes None. Exact note/velocity/marker data, duplicate/endpoint marker policy, random realization, repeat commit and undo scope U. For a groove using positive velocity values, committing to an audio clip creates a volume clip envelope to represent that velocity information as audio volume changes, overwriting a volume clip envelope already in the clip. This named envelope relation supplies no velocity-to-gain, point/curve, marker, sample or timing law.

contract.before: Clip groove can be auditioned by replacement while playing; pool exposes save/hot-swap. Dialog overwrite/cancel, replacement sharing, autosave, media locations and failure recovery U.
contract.after: Clip groove can be auditioned by replacement while playing; pool exposes save/hot-swap. Dialog overwrite/cancel, other-clip sharing/duplicate-entry behavior, autosave, media locations and failure recovery U. After enabling Clip Hot-Swap, double-clicking the selected alternative groove or pressing Enter loads it onto the clip and replaces the previously loaded groove in the Groove Pool as well. The source does not specify how other clips or duplicate/shared entry identities change.
